thread:
Liam: Massive thanks to Zoey + Rahul for rescuing the espresso machine this morning. lab was a sad burr grinder until you two showed up. :pray: :coffee:
Zoey: haha it was a team effort. Rahul found the stuck port, I calmed the steam wand panic. also cleaned the drip tray. :sweat_smile: :sparkles:
Rahul: Filed a tiny doc snippet in #office-life: `espresso-maintenance -> quick-fixes.md` so no one panics next time. added a 2-line checklist.
Marta: Literally heard the cheers from my desk. sending stickers + a $20 coffee card to each. :tada: :sticker:
Liam: Adding them to the kudos board now. this deserves a badge on the wall.
SnackBot: recorded recognition for Zoey (1) and Rahul (1). Generated voucher codes and posted to DM. (automated)
Zoey: also thank you to Facilities for the spare gasket. would not have worked without that part.
Rahul: pro-tip added to doc: `If grinder jams, run a dry grind cycle then clear hopper`. saved me from future despair.
Marta: can we get a team photo next time? imagine the "espresso heroes" sticker. :camera_with_flash: :coffee:
Liam: posted pic to thread: https://files.redwood/longshots/espresso-heroes.jpg (two sleepy but triumphant humans)
Zoey: this is why the office still matters. small acts, big morale. ❤️
Marta: weekly roundup blurb incoming. want to call out Facilities and the two of you.
Rahul: thanks everyone. caffeine for the win. :muscle:
